role: District Representative · Surigao del Norte, 2nd District
profileLabel: Restrictive-leaning on drug policy; mixed social values; mild left economics; institution-supporting (low confidence)
summary: Surigao del Norte 2nd District representative with 76 principal-authored bills. Authored the drug-crime death penalty, additional annulment grounds, an anti-dynasty ban, drug courts, wiretap-law amendments and detention contraband control. Co-authored tax-base and cooperative bills, plus women-in-politics and false-information measures. Most scores rest on few or co-authored bills.
caveat: Direction of the wiretap amendment (HB00914) was not verified and was excluded. Several scores rely on co-authored bills; confidence is Low.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored higher personal income tax exemption and rate restructuring (-1) with an estate tax amnesty extension (+2), averaged as tax; revised cooperative code (-1). All co-authored; thin.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: co-author HB09383, HB10345, HB06614, HB09584 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Mixed / moderate
social.rationale: Authored additional annulment grounds in the Family Code (-2) versus co-authored violence-against-women-in-politics bill (+2, discounted). Mixed, thin.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB00912; co-author HB08393 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Restrictive-leaning
civil.rationale: Authored death penalty for dangerous-drugs crimes (-4); co-authored false-information penalties (-2, discounted). Wiretap and detention bills not scored. A death-penalty position alone cannot set the dimension; sparse.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB01206; co-author HB09465 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Authored an anti-dynasty ban (HB00909, HB08389; +3) and co-authored penalties for diverting social service funds (+2). Two issues, bills only.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB00909, HB08389; co-author HB00606 (retrieved 2026-11-01)
